scripts.stage:cli: bash -c 'TARGET=$(rustc -vV | awk "/host:/ { print \$2 }") && cargo build --release -p wandel-cli && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp target/release/wandel src-tauri/binaries/wandel-cli-${TARGET} && chmod +x src-tauri/binaries/wandel-cli-${TARGET}'
scripts.build:mac:signed: bash -c 'set -a && [ -f .env ] && source .env && set +a && npm run stage:cli && npx tauri build'
